r1.exp: 1=C (Cheryl: 'I was a BUSGIRL in a nearby tavern'). 2=E (Elaine: 'frequenting the local bars and having tremendous fun'). 3=F (Forrest: 'persuaded to join the SQUASH CLUB'). 4=B (Bradley: 'was awarded a SCHOLARSHIP due to my high marks'). 5=A (Annabelle: 'If I had had a scholarship I wouldn't have lived in a DORMITORY'). 6=E (Elaine: 'met people who helped me through that rough year and NEVER ABANDONED ME AFTERWARDS'). 7=C (Cheryl: 'fairy-tale love story ended abruptly after my boyfriend left with no explanation'). 8=C (Cheryl: 'I LOOKED UP TO MY PROFESSORS, for they had achieved what I dreamt of'). 9=B (Bradley: 'the guys in the GARAGE REHEARSING TUNES'). 10=D (Dominic: 'my new friends moved on as they realised I WASN'T GOING TO MAKE IT'). 11=B (Bradley: 'they STOPPED FUNDING ME'). 12=A (Annabelle: 'all I could think about were the MATES I HAD LEFT BEHIND').

r13.exp: 'I wanted to hear about their dreams... I wanted to give them my complete attention' = osjećala je da propušta s djecom = C (missing her children).

r14.exp: 'Due to CONSIDERABLE LOSS OF INCOME, we ended up sending him back' = financijske teškoće = B.

r15.exp: 'She thought 25% was ACCEPTABLE' = škola je imala preniske standarde = B (The school's expectations were too low).

r16.exp: 'When my husband decided to LEAVE HIS JOB to start his own business' = očeva karijera = D.

r17.exp: 'I love being able to DECIDE WHEN TO DO WHAT' = sloboda u organizaciji vremena = A.

r18.exp: 'They yearn for spelling bees, science fairs... they can't tell how good they are' = žele usporediti se s vršnjacima = D.

r19.exp: 'The FIRST reaction... inevitable response to lapse. (19)____. It occurs when we PAY ATTENTION to the error.' → C: The SECOND signal arrives later and is associated with AWARENESS.

r20.exp: 'Fixed mind-set: can't change intelligence. (20)____. First see mistakes as failure, second as engine of education.' → G: The other has a GROWTH mind-set and they believe that we can get better at almost anything.

r21.exp: 'Quite a simple change. (21)____. Once they make a mistake, they immediately regret it.' → E: However, it induces frequent mistakes, as the boring procedure encourages people to zone out.

r22.exp: 'Increased attention correlated with improvement. (22)____. Thinking about what they got wrong → learn how to get it right.' → D: This inevitably implies that the extra awareness always pays dividends in performance.

r23.exp: 'Praising plays two roles. (23)____. This FEAR OF FAILURE → avoid learning from mistakes.' → A: Simply commending someone for 'being' smart stimulates the wish to 'look' smart, which means they shouldn't RISK MAKING A MISTAKE.

r24.exp: 'Making mistakes is irreplaceable component of learning. (24)____. It will keep making the same mistakes.' → H: Unless we experience the unpleasant symptoms of being wrong, our mind will never revise its models.

r25.exp: 'Exposure to technology MIGHT be reshaping your personality' — 'might' za mogućnost (nije sigurno, ali je moguće).

r26.exp: 'Excessive use MAKES us more impatient' — subjekt u jednini (excessive use) → 3. lice jednine 'makes'.

r27.exp: 'Clinic AT Stanford University' — prijedlog 'at' uz sveučilišta/institucije.

r28.exp: 'Pay a price IN terms of' — fiksni izraz: in terms of = u pogledu, što se tiče.

r29.exp: 'Is AKIN to an addiction' — fiksna kolokacija: akin to = nalik na, slično.

r30.exp: 'To identify THOSE at risk' — 'those' = oni (koji su ugroženi) — supstantivna zamjenica.

r31.exp: 'Do you often LOSE sleep' — fiksna kolokacija: lose sleep (over sth) = izgubiti san zbog nečega.

r32.exp: 'May be TAKING its toll on you' — fiksna kolokacija: take its toll on = štetno utjecati na.

r33.exp: 'Their quills, WHICH can reach 30 centimetres' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez).

r34.exp: 'Hard to remove BECAUSE of their microscopic barbs' — 'because of' = zbog (prijedložna fraza za razlog).

r35.exp: 'Famed for THEIR unique defence' (posvojna zamjenica) ili 'famed for A unique defence' (neodređeni član). Oba su prihvatljiva.

r36.exp: 'TO our knowledge this is the first' — fiksni izraz: to our/the best of our knowledge = prema našem znanju.

r37.exp: 'In order to understand HOW the quills perform their dual function' — neizravno pitanje: how = na koji način.

r38.exp: 'Less force THAN those without barbs' — komparativna konstrukcija: less... than = manje... od.

r39.exp: 'When IT came to removing the quills' — bezlična konstrukcija: when it comes to = kada je o... u pitanju.

r40.exp: 'IN conjunction with the claws' — fiksni izraz: in conjunction with = zajedno s, u kombinaciji s.
